licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These eleven buckets map cleanly onto the dominant clusters in the data: fraudulent licensure procurement, practice-level negligence/incompetence/misconduct, criminal convictions, improper seal/signature use, aiding unlicensed practice, statutory/rule violations, out-of-state disciplinary history, substance abuse/impairment, false or deceptive advertising and misrepresentation, undisclosed financial interests and conflicts of interest, and failures to cooperate with boards or report violations—together covering virtually every item without leaving a large residual.
